responsibility: This header defines the `generic_armv8_a_tunings` profile and companion default cost tables for a representative Armv8-A class machine in the AArch64 backend. Compared with the older fully generic model, it provides its own Armv8-A-flavored address, register-move, AdvSIMD, SVE, branch, approximation, prefetch, and `tune_params` data, giving GCC a more specific generic tuning target for modern Armv8-A cores and a reusable base for several derived per-core models.
